description: 1 double bedroom, 1 single bedroom, 1 bathroom with bathtub, 1 shower bathroom, open plan living-kitchen-dining, 1 storage room. Double-aspect apartment — windows on top and bottom facade(s). Kitchen is adjacent to a window — well-lit cooking position. 1 double bedroom (no walk-in wardrobe, no en-suite), 1 single bedroom(s). Single bedrooms can each function as bedroom, home office, hobby room or guest room. Kitchen: L-shaped, no island. Cook partially faces the living area depending on position at counter. No wall separates kitchen from dining and living — fully open plan. Living area arrangement: linear kitchen-dining-living. Dining table visible, approximately 6 seats. Bathroom config: 1 bathroom(s) with bathtub; 1 shower-only bathroom(s). Parallel morning routines possible — separate shower and WC available. Largest bedroom close to entry and kitchen — convenient morning access, less acoustic separation from activity. 0 of 1 single bedroom(s) have a desk visible in plan. The single bedroom is large enough to accommodate a bunk bed for two children. Possible configurations — mutually exclusive: (1) all as children's bedrooms; (2) all as home offices or hobby rooms; (3) one or both as guest rooms; (4) bunk bed arrangement extending household capacity. Storage room in entry or private zone, not adjacent to kitchen — suitable for coats, shoes, bikes, laundry or utility storage, not as kitchen pantry. Entry area has space for coat and shoe storage. From entry: kitchen is immediate, living area is short corridor. No door between entry and living/kitchen — relevant where local regulations require separation. Suits: couples needing a spare room.
not_suitable_for: jurisdictions requiring door separation between entry and kitchen
